purpose: Aesthetic memory index for training-aware DESIGNOSFORGE routing and PromptPacket v1.6 case selection.

batches.sample_caption: Close frontal product photo of a tall saturated purple retail shopping bag on a warm kraft paper background, black fabric handles, centered black vertical typography list on the side panel, lower text reading Chi VINTAGE, crisp folded paper base and strong shadowed side seam, fashion resale packaging mood.
sample_positive_notes: deep purple bag surface becomes the single anchor
vertical type column gives rhythm to the tall side panel
kraft background warms the saturated purple
sample_negative_notes: do not train third-party luxury brand names as reusable text
avoid making the bag surface muddy or underexposed
do not add extra props or retail clutter

batches.sample_caption: University discipline competition board for Culture China cultural tourism research, teal header with large Chinese research title, subtle illustrated Tianjin city background, project explanation block, extracted color palette swatches, four modular illustrated information-visualization panels about river transport, culture, city aesthetics and value analysis, plus a bottom application display strip with phone cases, booklets, posters, transit media and exhibition scenarios.
sample_positive_notes: strong separation between research title, project explanation, infovis panels and application display
teal academic header creates a consistent non-commercial competition identity
hand-drawn cultural tourism illustrations give regional warmth without losing board order
sample_negative_notes: do not copy or generate the large diagonal watermark as a design element
avoid turning dense illustrated sub-panels into uncontrolled clutter
do not treat this as a commercial campaign poster or product advertisement

batches.sample_caption: Three-poster identity system for the Chinese Cultural Center of Milan, cream poster fields on a deep oxblood-brown presentation board, modular circular C-like symbols in cyan, orange-red, and pale yellow, bold stacked sans typography, Italian and English cultural-center naming, geometric grid composition, strong negative space, disciplined institutional visual identity.
sample_positive_notes: clear modular logo language across three poster variants
limited civic palette creates strong recognition
cream and oxblood fields keep contrast warm and cultural
sample_negative_notes: do not copy the exact institutional logo as a universal symbol
avoid adding decorative Chinese motifs or random brush textures
do not turn small footer text into pseudo-language blocks

batches.sample_caption: Competition exhibition board for The Waiting Machine, showing a public spatial installation render with light wood mechanical waterwheel-like structure, gray architectural interior, dark lattice ceiling, wood wall panel, human scale cutout figures, bold Chinese title 露骨的期待, English title The Waiting Machine, and a lower design concept text strip in a clean white board layout.
sample_positive_notes: strong opening board that combines project title, spatial render, and concept paragraph
installation is readable as a wood mechanical public device
human figures provide scale without dominating the scene
sample_negative_notes: do not overtrain cutout people style as required for all boards
avoid turning the dark lattice ceiling into random dirty visual noise
do not generate dense Chinese concept copy without verified text

batches.sample_caption: High-end Chinese black tea packaging, a single white cylindrical tea container with a warm bamboo lid, vertical red textured paper or fabric seal label, abstract black brand mark, dense small Chinese body text on the lower label, centered on a clean pale gray studio background with soft grounding shadow and restrained negative space.
sample_positive_notes: large quiet background with controlled grain
red vertical label creates a clear hierarchy against white ceramic surface
sample_negative_notes: do not over-train the gray background grain as intentional decoration
do not invent extra seals, ornaments, tea leaves, or random cultural motifs
avoid pseudo-Chinese text; treat dense small copy as high-risk unless exact source text is supplied
